proposed_protocol.approval_status: Protocol values and the pinned local Llama scorer are selected; exact run-level approval is required before benchmark inference.
proposed_protocol.judge_data_boundary: Question, gold answer, and candidate answer are processed by the local pinned Llama scorer; no benchmark-derived data is sent to external model endpoints.

proposed_acceptance.evidence_noninferiority: model-guided evidence-turn recall is no more than 0.05 below recency
proposed_acceptance.full_history_reference: report separately as the uncompressed reference; no admission threshold is assigned
proposed_acceptance.minimum_improvement: at least 0.05 improvement over recency in answer accuracy or evidence-turn recall at the primary budget
proposed_acceptance.primary_budget_noninferiority: paired 95% CI lower bound for model-guided minus recency answer accuracy is greater than -0.03

proposed_protocol.scoring: Answer accuracy, evidence-turn recall, retained-token ratio, question-type and answerability breakdowns, and runtime/memory. Record cold load time; p50/p95 compaction, answer, and scorer latency; host peak RSS; and MLX peak memory where available. Compare full history and matched-budget recency with model-guided compaction.

proposed_scorer.comparability: This is not the official Llama 3.1 70B or GPT-4o scorer; scores are exploratory and not directly comparable to published scorer results.
proposed_scorer.label_rule: case-insensitive substring 'yes' in the returned text
proposed_scorer.persistence: Persist only boolean labels and aggregate metrics; do not save scorer prompts or raw responses.
proposed_scorer.prompt: The exact pinned LongMemEval question-type and abstention-specific judge prompt
proposed_scorer.runtime: MLX-LM in-process using the existing pinned DMS-13 runtime

repository.scorer_method_note: The pinned official evaluator registers GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, and local Llama 3.1 70B. It uses question-type-specific official prompts, temperature 0, max_tokens 10, and treats any response containing 'yes' as correct. The two API options send question, gold answer, and candidate answer outside the host; the documented local option requires serving infrastructure and a 70B model.

runtime_proposal.boundary: One in-process local runtime for Von CPU compaction, Qwen MLX answering, and Llama 3.1 8B MLX judging; no model server and no benchmark-data requests to external model endpoints.
